enchantments.tooltip: Quality Accuracy +2: Passive: +2 Quality bonus to attack rolls
Quality Seeker +1: Provides a +1 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +1 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Minor Action Boost Enhancement: This will increase the total number of Action Boosts you can use by 1. However, these additional Action Boosts will only take effect after the wielder rests.

Nearly Complete: Insightful Ability Score: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to the forges on the upper floor of Gravenhollow and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.text: This item can be upgraded with one of the following:

children.tooltip: Insightful Charisma +2: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Constitution +2: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Insightful Dexterity +2: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Intelligence +2: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Insightful Strength +2: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Strength.
Insightful Wisdom +2: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +2 Insight bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Neck Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
